findings: Post-restart listener diagnostics recorded 127 CLOSE_FAILED_WRONG_THREAD events across many owner threads. The failures were overwhelmingly non-write-lane connections, so they are not the repaired _update_creator_write path.

The generic reaper selects connections older than 20 seconds and calls close from db-conn-reaper. SQLite connections are thread-affine, so every foreign close fails by design and repeats on later reaper cycles.

Snapshots show managed_db_connect-labelled owners accumulating CLOSE_FAILED_WRONG_THREAD state; some snapshots also contain in-transaction/write-lane work, including usage_tracker and price synchronization paths. Owner cleanup must remain on the owner thread.
The local API health endpoint timed out again after 10 seconds, so recovery cannot be claimed.
oip_v2_2e_2b2ac_reaper_root_cause_analys.root_cause: The reaper's foreign-thread close policy is incompatible with SQLite thread affinity. The B2AB finally repair removes one leaked creator writer, but cannot resolve the generic lifecycle-policy mismatch or establish database recovery.

oip_v2_2e_2b2ad_owner_thread_reaper_poli.policy: A foreign db-conn-reaper may mark a stale connection OWNER_THREAD_CLEANUP_REQUIRED once, but must not inspect transaction state, rollback, or close a thread-affine SQLite connection. Existing owner-thread finally/context-manager cleanup remains responsible for native cleanup.
